about: Genealogy of the feature study: every script version and every run it produced, kept unchanged. The site's Archive page is generated from this file. Edit the text here; the file lists are filled in by site_builder/build_site.py.

runs.label: mk1 round 1
runs.note: First full pass: KS D per feature, region (barrel / endcap / all) and mass point, pooled and equal-weight combinations. Three 193-page PDFs, one per region.

entries.what: Signal vs background KS pass. Inventory of all columns across the 7 files, ALL7 feature pool, HARD_EXCLUDE, exclude_features.txt, NaN / -999 handling, region auto-detection.
entries.changes: Starting point. Fixes made during the session: summary crash on tied scores; endcap defined by msvtx_inEndcaps_NOSYS == 1 (was inBarrel == 0).
entries.superseded_by: mk3 / mk4 block B (same scores, plus duplicates removed and noise floor).

runs.label: mk2 · cut htmissScalar >= 40 GeV
runs.note: Cut applied to both samples on htmissScalar_NOSYS (see selection_report.txt). Background keeps only its 2+-jet events (7,610 of 36,059), so the 'after cut' rankings compare signal with 2+-jet background, not with background in the signal region. Its bkg_split.csv (background below vs above the cut = 0-1 jets vs 2+ jets) is still the best test of which features depend on jet activity, and the site uses it.

runs.label: mk2 · cut htmiss_NOSYS >= 40 GeV
runs.note: Zero background events survive the cut in every region. This run is how the disjoint HTmiss selection was found: background htmiss_NOSYS < 40 GeV, signal >= 40 GeV. No after-cut rankings exist.

runs.label: mk2 · cut htmiss >= 40 and met_met >= 20 GeV
runs.note: Zero background events survive. Its selection_report.txt also shows that every signal event has met_met_NOSYS >= 20.07 GeV while 52% of background is below 20 GeV: a second edge in the signal selection (see Findings).

entries.what: Two selections side by side (all events, and a preselection applied to both samples), one PDF per feature with all regions and both selections, background below-vs-above-cut check, rank-identical duplicates collapsed.
entries.changes: Adds --presel cuts, selection_report.txt, compare_all_vs_<cut>.csv, bkg_split.csv, duplicates.txt, per-feature folders.
entries.superseded_by: mk3 dropped the preselection once the HTmiss split was understood; mk4 turned it into a unit test. bkg_split is carried onto the site from out_sigbg_mk2_r1.

runs.label: mk3 round 1 (tables only)
runs.note: Run without per-feature plots. Scores, NN-list table and unit test are identical in content to mk4's 00_common and B_mc_vs_data.

entries.what: HTmiss unit test, one folder and PDF per feature, NN feature-list table (nn_features_mk4.txt resolved to CSV columns), strongest features unused by the NN lists, noise floor with effective sample size.
entries.changes: Adds unit_tests.txt, nn_feature_scores.csv, D_crit. Drops the preselection.

runs.label: mk4 round 1 (current)
runs.note: Everything on the main pages of this site.

entries.what: Four analysis blocks: A barrel vs endcap, B MC vs data, C correlation and redundancy blocks, D prototype input sets with a gradient-boosted surrogate; GAMBIT inputs (pools, blocks, drop suggestions).
entries.changes: Adds blocks A, C, D, gambit_inputs, htmiss-linked / non-physics / suspicious categories. In the repo: data folder read from --data / config.txt / KJ_SIGBG_DATA (analysis unchanged).

entries.what: Console checks of the HTmiss edge, background survival after an htmissScalar cut, and the background jet-count structure (two one-liners).
entries.superseded_by: tools/selection_check.py (same checks plus per-region jet counts and the MET edge).
